title: One pinch against the tenement
priorStoryState: Sera Voss's Death Debts have mixed a child's Last Word into her own childhood. She keeps a journal to remember her real name. High Warden Marchand has restricted all Veins of Lethe from the mines. Her Lethe Supplier still has one illicit pinch. Tonight she cannot tell which memories in the journal are hers. She has not yet told anyone that the Ashen Compass went dark.
brief: Write the beat at the supplier's door after midnight. He will hand over the pinch only if she tells him what the Compass did at the tenement. She needs the dose to know her name in the morning. One of them has to yield something that cannot be taken back: the pinch, or the fact of the dark Compass.
